# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.
# After item 2: the base is gfx1100/gfx1101's default, buffer loads with TID; rel is the release before it.
base=
rel=-DPEARL_AMD_RDNA3_BUFLD=0
pfx=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1
pin=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1
pinc=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
st=-DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
